grain: one row per canonical trade_date and stock_code

dimensions.feature: price, lifecycle, tradability, adjustment, corporate action, text and model feature columns

required_columns.trade_state: enum: not_listed, delisted, suspended, no_weekly_bar, tradable, inactive_or_unknown

invariants: primary key is unique and non-null
universe_member_pit implies is_listed_asof and not is_delisted_asof
model_eligible_pit implies universe_member_pit, has_price_observation and not is_suspended
sample_eligible_v2 implies model_eligible_pit and preserves the date-level chronological split
future listing, status, capital and adjustment events are never backfilled
suspended or missing-bar stocks are retained in the dense panel
current snapshot listing status is not used to rewrite historical membership
